examples.title: CRBN with lenalidomide, recruiting IKZF1
examples.shows: The cleanest case in the set. The molecule sits deep in cereblon's pocket and presents a small, strongly directional face, and the zinc finger covers almost all of it -- 94% of the presented face buried, the highest of the fourteen. It is also the only system where the built-in docking engine recovered the crystal placement, so it is the one example where every stage of the tool can be run end to end.

examples.title: CRBN with lenalidomide, recruiting CK1α
examples.shows: The same ligase and the same chemistry recruiting an entirely different protein. That is the premise of molecular glue in one pair of files, and it is worth opening beside 6H0F: the presented face is nearly identical, 74.8 against 72.6 square angstroms, and what arrives to sit on it is not.

examples.title: CDK12–cyclin K glued to DDB1
examples.shows: A glue with no ligase pocket involved at all: the molecule binds CDK12 and DDB1 is recruited straight onto it. Useful as a check that the gate is measuring interfaces rather than having learned to recognise cereblon, since nothing about this system resembles the first two.

examples.title: DCAF15 with E7820, recruiting RBM39
examples.shows: The largest cavity in the benchmark at 1274 cubic angstroms, which makes it the clearest illustration of what the cavity view is for -- that is the space chemistry would have to fill. One caveat is visible in its own numbers: the face has a directionality of 0.34, barely above the threshold where the tool stops trusting the approach direction at all.

examples.title: DCAF15 with indisulam, recruiting RBM39 — the hard case
examples.shows: The same two proteins as 6UD7 with a different ligand, and a different verdict: borderline rather than pass. The ligand lies in a shallow groove rather than a pocket, so it presents 343 square angstroms of broad flat face at 36% buried, and a face like that restrains a docking search weakly -- many wrong placements cover it. Included on purpose. A tool worth trusting has to be seen saying "not sure", and the pair with 6UD7 shows the verdict following the chemistry rather than the proteins.
